newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Inkombank to issue Eurocommercial paper.
newsitem.headline: Russia Inkombank to issue Eurocommercial paper.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest banks, AB Inkombank has signed an agreement with SBC Warburg to issue European commercial paper, the bank's President Vladimir Vinogradov said on Friday.
He also said the bank planned a Eurobond issue in June.
"The first placement of $20 million of (European commercial paper) will take place in three weeks," Vinogradov told a news conference.
"Later, in another three weeks, if quotes are favourable and we sell the paper successfully, we can attract a further $60 to $80 million."
He did not say what the maturity of the paper would be.
The agreement with Warburg did not specify the placement volume, he said.
Vinogradov said that after Inkombank had completed the eurocommercial paper placement, it would issue Eurobonds.

"(In six weeks) the work on eurocommercial paper with SBC Warburg will be over, and we shall move on to a Eurobond issue," he said. "I think the first issue of our bank's two to three-year Eurobond will take place in June."
He did name managers or the volume of the proposed Eurobond.
Inkombank is the second Russian bank planning a Eurobond issue. In January, Uneximbank said it planned a Eurobond issue for up to $200 million in mid-1997.
